global_style: Opulent Art Deco glamour; warm golden palette; shallow depth of field; smooth camera glide; exterior night fireworks backlight; romantic nostalgia.

key_events: Camera glides past blurred partygoers toward a tuxedoed man.
Golden fireworks erupt, bathing the scene in warm light.
He turns, revealing a rare, magnetic smile.
He raises a crystal coupe in a silent toast.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Jazz Age opulence and high-society parties; Art Deco aesthetics; champagne-fueled celebration.

characters.backstory: Little revealed; known simply as "Gatsby" amid a lavish 1920s party.
characters.current_motivation: To reveal his identity and offer a silent, reassuring toast.
